mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint series interaction.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals real economic contraction, which precedes corporate profit deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during economic downturns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 4.5% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls below 135,000 thousand persons signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS falls below 135,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production above 105 (index 2017=100) signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
